your_book:
Jaleel's book had a mixed but broadly constructive Friday. The two heaviest positions pulled in opposite directions: NVDA (12.5% weight, +1.49% today, up 15.5% overall) continued to carry its weight, while the analyst chatter around a 31%-upside target for ABT (9.6% weight, +0.73%) gave that name a quiet tailwind. AVGO popped +3.37% on news of a $60B AI-customer financing plan, and RKLB surged +4.92% — though at a QARP of 37.4 and an AVOID verdict, that move flatters a position the model has little conviction in. ONON (+2.22%) and NBIX (+1.88%) also added constructively from smaller slots.

The drag came from several names already in the hole. BSX fell another -1.60% and sits -13.2% overall, with a guidance cut flagged as elevated risk and an earnings print due October 28 that will need to deliver. LULU dropped -1.78% on the day and is now down -26.4% in the book — the widest single-name gap — while ADBE slipped -1.75% and continues to trade on fear rather than fundamentals. ADBE's beat-and-raise in June hasn't mattered; AI-narrative pressure and a CFO exit are running the show. AZO (-0.7%, -8.3% overall) and EXE (-0.59%, -8.7% overall) both drift quietly against their STRONG BUY ratings.

The book as a whole sits at -2.58% unrealized, so capital preservation is under mild but real pressure across several mid-weight names. The strongest thesis-versus-price divergences to watch heading into Monday: BSX into its Oct 28 print, LULU where the gap between the -26.4% loss and a STRONG BUY verdict demands fresh justification, and RKLB where today's pop in an AVOID-rated name raises the question of whether the position sizing still makes sense.

attention.headline: Down -13.2% with guidance slashed; Oct 28 print is the line in the sand
attention.note: BSX dropped another -1.60% today and carries an elevated risk flag — FY26 growth guidance was cut from 10.5% to 7–8.5% with management guiding flat through Q3; with earnings on Oct 28, Jaleel needs a clear view on whether to reduce ahead of or hold through that catalyst.

attention.headline: -26.4% overall on a STRONG BUY — the thesis-versus-price gap is the widest in the book
attention.note: Americas comps are negative for the fifth straight period, tariffs have gutted margins, and China has stalled; the model rating hasn't moved, but the loss is accelerating and the next catalyst isn't until Dec 9, leaving a long, uncomfortable drift window.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated name surged +4.92% today — does the position still belong?
attention.note: RKLB carries the book's lowest QARP (37.4) and an AVOID verdict; today's pop on whale-activity noise rather than a fundamental catalyst is exactly the kind of moment to re-examine whether the 7.6% weight is intentional or an oversight that a rally now makes cheaper to exit.

attention.headline: Narrative, not numbers, keeps selling ADBE off despite a beat-and-raise
attention.note: Down -1.75% today and -3.3% overall, the AI-disruption fear around Claude Design and the CFO exit are overriding solid fundamentals; with the next print on Dec 9, the watch question is whether sentiment can stabilize or whether the weight should be trimmed before the story gets worse.
